title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-22 01:26:54 最新章节：第2708章 被撕掉的天书
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
“所以我这是穿越了？”
罗天在一间古香古色的房间内醒来。
用了好长时间才明白发生了什么情况。
“天渊界、北域、风临洲、夜风国、边北城罗家，又懒又馋的败家子少主罗天？靠，这人设简直完美啊！”
罗天兴奋的一拍大腿！
一无是处的富二代，这可是罗天前世的人生理想。
毕竟，早年父母双亡的他，从小就为钱所困。
否则，他也不会一边上学，一边打工赚生活费。
更不会在雨夜里骑车兼职送外卖，被一辆闯红灯的大卡车撞死了。
“不过武道为尊的世界，一个有钱的废物，是不是太危险了？”
罗天陷入了思考。
自己现在有亲爹罗峰罩着还好。
可万一哪天亲爹挂了，自己家里这么有钱，还这么废物……
估计会死得很销魂。
“不行，看来想当一辈子有钱人，还是得有点实力才行！”
“不过我这一世为什么这么废物？难道说……”
罗天猛的拿起自己的空间戒指敲了敲。
“前辈？你在里面么？”
戒指安安静静，没有回答。
“没有戒指里的老爷爷么？那难道是祖传的吊坠？滴血认主的那种？”

罗天立刻将吊坠摘下，然后咬破手指，滴了一滴血上去。
依然安安静静。
“嗯？那不是吊坠的话，是扳指？玉佩？玉笛？宝剑？……花瓶？古画？……拖鞋？痰盂？尿壶？”
罗天将房间里的所有东西，全都用血滴了一遍。
然而除了血渍之外，什么都没有。
“我……有点晕，有点冷。”
罗天赶紧披着棉被坐下。
这一圈滴血认主下来，他都贫血了。
“唉，看来不是传统玄幻，那……系统？系统你爹在此，还不来觐见？”
安静如鸡。
“系统大哥，我刚才说话不好听，出来见见？”
寂寞如狗。
“系统大爹，来见见你孙子吧！”
一阵风吹过，屋外传来一阵乌鸦的叫声。
“靠，不是吧！
连系统都没有的？凡人流？那可苦了！”
罗天无奈摇头。
但就在这时。
嗡！
他脑子里一阵鸣响。
content_en:
"So I've traveled through time?"
Luo Tian woke up in an antique room.
It took me a long time to understand what was going on.
"Tianyuan Realm, Beiyu, Fenglinzhou, Yefeng Kingdom, Bianbeicheng Luo Family, the lazy and greedy prodigal young master Luo Tian? Damn, this character is simply perfect!"
Luo Tian slapped his thigh excitedly!
A good-for-nothing rich second generation was Luo Tian's ideal in his previous life.
After all, his parents died young and he has been troubled by money since he was a child.
Otherwise, he would not go to school and work to earn living expenses at the same time.
Not to mention riding a bicycle part-time to deliver food on a rainy night, only to be hit and killed by a large truck that ran a red light.
"But in a world where martial arts is respected, isn't it too dangerous for a rich loser?"
Luo Tian fell into thinking.
It's a good thing that he has his own father, Luo Feng, protecting him now.
But what if my biological father dies one day and my family is so rich but still such a waste...
He will probably die in ecstasy.
"No, it seems that if you want to be a rich man for the rest of your life, you still have to have some strength!"
"But why am I such a waste in this life? Could it be that..."
Luo Tian fiercely picked up his space ring and knocked it.
"Senior? Are you in there?"
The ring was quiet and did not answer.
"Isn't there an old man in the ring? Is that an ancestral pendant? The kind that recognizes its owner by shedding blood?"
Luo Tian immediately took off the pendant, then bit his finger and dripped a drop of blood on it.
Still quiet.
"Huh? If that's not a pendant, is it a ring? A jade pendant? A jade flute? A sword?... A vase? An ancient painting?... Slippers? A spittoon? A urinal?"
Luo Tian drizzled blood on everything in the room.
But there was nothing but blood stains.
"I'm...a little dizzy and a little cold."
Luo Tian quickly sat down with his quilt wrapped around him.
After this circle of blood dripping down, he became anemic.
"Well, it doesn't seem like traditional fantasy, then... the system? Your father is here, why don't you come to see him?"
Quiet as a chicken.
"Brother System, what I said just now was not nice. Can you come out and meet me?"
Lonely as a dog.
"System Daddy, come and meet your grandson!"
A gust of wind blew by, and a crow's cry came from outside the house.
“Damn, no!
Not even a system? Mortal flow? That’s so painful! "
Luo Tian shook his head helplessly.
But that's it.
Buzz!
There was a ringing in his head.
